source_pins.source_note: These pins identify the inspected baseline, not normative authority; the workflow records exact checkouts per run.

execution_boundary.raw_artifact_octets: Receiver input is an opaque byte sequence; invalid UTF-8 in the artifact itself is not automatically an input rejection.
execution_boundary.receipt_json: Strict JSON receipt parsing is a separate boundary and must not be conflated with raw artifact intake.

cases.mutation: Synthetic bytes containing NUL and non-UTF-8 octets
cases.expected: Exact octets preserved; octet length equals byte count; digest equals SHA-256 of received bytes

cases.mutation: Use PASS, FAIL, CONFORMANT, NON_CONFORMANT, null, or integer as handoff.status
cases.expected: Rejected at typed constructor or strict JSON enum boundary; no valid receipt emitted
cases.ri_rs: Enum deserialization rejection; production constructor has closed enum

cases.mutation: Omit fixture object or set fixture_id / fixture_artifact_identity empty
cases.expected: Receipt construction or validation rejects incomplete fixture identity (R-VAL-002)

cases.mutation: Pass hex or Base64 text instead of octets to the raw-octet API
cases.expected: Reject text input; encoded text must not be hashed as if it were the raw artifact
cases.ri_rs: Native API type is Vec<u8>; wire-consumer coverage is separate

cases.mutation: Set received.octet_length to a value different from decoded raw-octet length
Change recomputed_sha256 without changing raw octets
cases.expected: Reject (R-VAL-005); expected digest must not be caller-supplied

cases.mutation: Empty receiver_id, implementation_id, implementation_version, or source_commit
Add conformance_result, verdict, acceptance_state, or digest_output_state to wire receipt
cases.expected: Strict BC-02.1 consumer must reject unknown/authority-bearing fields
cases.ri_rs: Serde-derived BoundaryReceipt deserialization ignores unknown fields by default

cases.mutation: Add an unrecognized field at top-level or nested object
cases.expected: Strict schema consumer rejects the extra field; no silent ignore
cases.ri_rs: Serde-derived structs ignore unknown fields by default

cases.mutation: Supply valid Base64 string for received.raw_octets in BC-02.1 transport receipt
cases.expected: Consumer decodes Base64 to exact raw octets, checks decoded length and computes digest over decoded bytes
cases.ri_py: Serializer/decoder helper exists, but no full receipt deserializer located
cases.ri_rs: Wire emitter uses Base64; logical DTO Vec<u8> serializes as an array, with no reciprocal parser located

cases.mutation: Invalid Base64 alphabet, padding, or impossible decoded length
cases.expected: Reject receipt; do not substitute empty bytes or continue with a recomputed digest
cases.ri_py: decode helper rejects malformed Base64; no full receipt parser located
cases.ri_rs: No reciprocal BC-02.1 receipt parser located

cases.mutation: Required field missing, null, wrong nested type, float/bool/negative octet_length, or malformed JSON
cases.expected: Reject at receipt parsing boundary with stable error category
cases.ri_rs: Serde type parsing partially rejects malformed shape but is not a complete BC-02.1 wire consumer

cases.mutation: Duplicate schema_id, handoff.status, or received.recomputed_sha256 keys
cases.expected: Reject duplicate-key JSON before receipt interpretation; do not rely on last-key-wins parsing
cases.ri_rs: No explicit duplicate-key policy for a BC-02.1 wire consumer

cases.mutation: Malformed UTF-8 in a receipt JSON envelope
cases.expected: Reject malformed receipt transport; this does not imply rejecting arbitrary raw artifact octets

cases.mutation: Use raw synthetic artifact bytes that are not valid UTF-8
cases.expected: Receiver records exact raw bytes; only a separate receipt-JSON boundary validates UTF-8

gate_rule: Preparation CI success is not C6 PASS. C6 remains BLOCKED until a common BC-02.1 receipt JSON consumer exists or is explicitly defined for both implementations, known strict-schema gaps are resolved, and the same fixture-derived mutation corpus runs against both pinned native paths.
